caption: The drawing shows a rectangular section of patterned wallpaper consisting of a blue background with thin vertical black stripes evenly spaced across the entire area. Overlaid on the stripes are repeating white floral motifs, each with stylized leaves and flowers. These floral motifs are contained within interconnected oval lattice structures made of curved, white, leaf-like borders that intersect in a grid-like arrangement. At each intersection of the curved borders, there are symmetrical, geometric flower-like shapes with four white petals centered on a black oval, featuring small blue details at the petal tips. The composition alternates the floral motifs and the geometric flower shapes in a regular, repeating pattern, all rendered in shades of blue, white, and black. The design is bordered by an off-white margin.
title: Wallpaper
